title: The Army That Lost a War to Birds

camera_idea.name: The Flock That Outsmarted the Gun
camera_idea.why: Start on the soldier and gun, reveal the enormous wheat field, track the emus through the fence, then return to the baffled soldier.
camera_idea.signature: A low tracking move follows the flock while the gun and truck shrink behind it.

sentences.text: A soldier aimed a machine gun at a flock of emus in a wheat field.
sentences.subject: anthony

sentences.text: But the birds split apart, ran through the fence, and vanished into the golden grass.
sentences.subject: chief

sentences.text: The army brought trucks, ammunition, and confidence. The emus brought speed.
sentences.subject: usaa_boss

sentences.text: After days of chasing them, the soldiers had one problem: the birds were winning.
sentences.subject: anthony

sentences.text: The Great Emu War ended with the emus still running.
sentences.subject: chief
